title: BUILDING THE FIVEFOLD
summary: From quiet groves to ruined arenas: a world shaped around five lanes.
detailIntro: A world built around the decisions you make.
paragraphs: The Fivefold brings two distinct factions onto one shared battlefield. Dawnward and the Ashen Court meet across five ordered lanes, where your choices of hero, deck and timing shape each match.
This mock editorial introduces the world through its visual contrasts: living greens and pale stone, warm embers and deep shadow. The final article will be supplied by the OathFront team.
